top_signals.title: Rising US Bond Yields Show No Sign of Slowing
top_signals.summary:
This year, an important psychological barrier for the bond market was crossed. Yields across different US Treasury maturities exceeded levels not seen in decades. And they show no sign of slowing down.
 (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Leaders with Francine Lacqua - Season 2 Trailer
top_signals.summary: What drives the world’s most influential minds? In Leaders with Francine Lacqua, we sit down with the decision-makers shaping our future to explore the personal stories behind their public personas. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
